topic: Sukuna stepped in to save Megumi in Shibuya because the body was the prize, not out of kindness
title: Sukuna Saved Megumi Because He Wanted His Body
description: Sukuna stepped into the Shibuya fight to keep Megumi alive, and the reason was never kindness. Here is the Mahoraga fight and the Culling Game takeover in under a minute.
comment: Was Sukuna saving Megumi's life, or was he protecting the vessel he always wanted?

lines.text: Sukuna saved Megumi in Shibuya, and the reason was never kindness.

shot.fallback: anime style, a smirking king with tattoos looking down at a sorcerer

lines.text: Megumi summoned Mahoraga as a last resort, and it nearly cost him everything.

shot.fallback: anime style, a young sorcerer summoning a giant divine general

lines.text: Then Sukuna arrived just as Shigemo was about to finish the job.

shot.fallback: anime style, a king appearing above a crowded plaza

lines.text: Why would he stop a fight he could win? Because Megumi was the vessel he wanted.

shot.fallback: anime style, a king's eye glowing as he looks at a sorcerer

lines.text: Mahoraga adapts, so Sukuna's Dismantle stopped working.

shot.fallback: anime style, a divine general standing firm under a glowing cut

lines.text: Then its wheel mended every gash, and Sukuna switched tactics.

shot.fallback: anime style, a spinning golden wheel above a divine general

lines.text: He opened Malevolent Shrine, with a range reportedly kept near 140 meters.

shot.fallback: anime style, a glowing domain over a city street

lines.text: Then came a fire arrow that destroyed Mahoraga and a huge part of Shibuya.

shot.fallback: anime style, a blazing arrow over a ruined city skyline

lines.text: Later, in the Culling Game, he took the body for real.

shot.search: Sukuna takes Megumi body Culling Game
shot.fallback: anime style, a king's shadow falling over a sorcerer

lines.text: He forced a finger into Megumi, and Megumi was trapped inside his own head.

shot.fallback: anime style, a glowing finger above a sorcerer trapped in a dark void

lines.text: Here is the verdict: Megumi was never outmatched in skill. He was outmatched in control.

shot.fallback: anime style, a young sorcerer with a hand outstretched, shadows slipping away

lines.text: The Ten Shadows answers to whoever holds the body, and Sukuna held it.

shot.search: Ten Shadows Sukuna holds body Megumi
shot.fallback: anime style, a king's hand gripping a sorcerer's shoulder over a glowing seal

lines.text: The body was the prize all along, so the rescue in Shibuya was never really a rescue.

shot.fallback: anime style, a king lifting a sorcerer from rubble with a grin

self_check.hook: Opens on the claim that Sukuna's rescue was never kindness, which names Sukuna and Megumi in the first line.
self_check.loop: The final line sets up the rescue as a prize, which leads straight back into the claim in line 1.
